title: Questionnaire Delta Composer & SLA Commitment Bundler for Enterprise Compliance Requests
creator: Priya Singh
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers frequently submit large vendor/customer questionnaires (SOC2/ISO, HIPAA, GDPR, DPA, bespoke RfIs) that differ from our canonical control mappings. Triage today is manual: SE/PM reads the questionnaire, compiles a bespoke evidence bundle, negotiates SLA language with Legal/Security, and surfaces commitments back to the customer. This leads to long turnaround times, inconsistent commitments, and duplicated effort across accounts.

Goal: Build a productized triage flow that (1) computes a precise 'delta' between a customer's questionnaire and Redwood's canonical control coverage, (2) automatically groups questions into evidence bundles and engineering remediation asks, (3) composes a recommended SLA/commitment statement (templated by level of risk and account tier), and (4) surfaces a human-review workflow for Legal/Security to approve and publish responses.

Scope: Minimum viable delivery will accept uploaded questionnaires (CSV/Docx/XLS/PDF), parse questions and control mappings, output a categorized delta report (Covered / Documented / Requires Remediation / Negotiable), generate an evidence bundle checklist (linked to our Evidence Store), and produce a suggested SLA template and negotiation notes for Account/SE. Integrations: Confluence/Drive links for evidence, GitHub PR template generation for remediation engineering tasks, Console ticket creation for Dedicated/Private customers, and an audit trail in the Compliance Evidence Store.

Non-goals: Automated legal sign-off, auto-remediation of platform gaps, or realtime contractual amendments without human approval.

Success metrics: median turnaround time from questionnaire receipt to proposed response (target <= 3 business days), % of requests closed without engineering work (target 45%), time saved per request for SE/PM (target >= 75% reduction), and legal approval time (target <= 2 business days after initial bundle).
acceptance_criteria: Upload and parse questionnaire files into discrete question items with confidence score >= 80% for >= 90% of inputs.
Produce a delta report with clear categories: Covered, Documented, Requires Remediation, Negotiable.
Auto-generate evidence bundle with links to existing artifacts or a placeholder task if missing.
Generate an SLA/commitment draft using tenant tier and risk heuristics; draft editable by SE/PM and Legal.
Create a human-review workflow where Security/Legal can approve, reject, or request edits; every action logged in Compliance Evidence Store.
Create integrations: GitHub remediation PR template and a Console ticket when engineering work is required.
Provide exportable report (PDF/Docx) for customer response and keep internal audit trail for future requests.
tasks: Design data model for question-to-control mapping and delta scoring
Prototype parser pipeline (PDF/Docx/XLS/CSV) and question normalization heuristics
Define risk tiers and SLA template library (Tier 1/2/3 customers)
Build evidence bundler UI in Console with links to Evidence Store and ability to attach new artifacts
Implement GitHub remediation PR templating and Console ticket creation flow
Build human-review queue for Security/Legal with approval comments and redlines
Add analytics events to measure turnaround time and closed-without-eng metrics
Write runbook and handoff checklist for Solutions Engineering and Customer Success
